prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Save Account Sync Guarantee: Displays an explicit account cloud-sync guarantee banner on the sign-in screen reassuring users that existing pets and progress are preserved. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again, creating friction during sign-in (74.1% completion).)
1: [home, wait_info] Live Pet Spawning Animation Banner: Adds an animated mascot preview and stage loading indicator during pet initialization to show desktop rendering progress. (why: Waiting step has a long mean time (2336s) and 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop or app failing to launch.)
2: [home, notification] Background Rendering Ready Notification: Enables system tray notifications and audio cue when desktop pet asset generation finishes so users can safely switch windows while waiting. (why: The waiting step has a very high mean duration (2336s), suggesting users alt-tab away and forget the desktop app is loading.)
3: [sign_in, incentive] Sign-in Account Protection Badge: Adds a badge highlighting pet backup security and instant unlock benefits when creating or logging into an account. (why: Sign in drop-off is 74.1% and 8 users complained about losing pets when re-logging.)
4: [choose_path, reorder] Story Narrative Reordering Journey: Places the narrative story intro upfront as a full-bleed carousel to build emotional connection before presenting path options. (why: Over 23% drop at initial path selection step; introducing narrative context first builds emotional investment.)
